name: Seared Veggie Sausage with Creamy Mushroom-Spinach Sauté
instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add sausages and cook, turning occasionally, until warmed through, about 5 minutes (or cook sausages according to package instructions). Transfer sausages to a plate and loosely cover with foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Meanwhile, place spinach in a colander and rinse under hot, running water (from the tap) to defrost; set aside to drain further.
When the sausages are done, return skillet to medium heat. Add more butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add shallot and mushrooms; cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms soften, 2-3 minutes.

Add spinach, cream, and spices to the skillet; stir to combine and bring to a simmer. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook until spinach is warmed through and sauce thickens slightly, 1-2 minutes. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide sausages and creamy veggie sauté between plates. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
